title: What Did Ancient Humans Do For Pleasure? 🏺 (The Untold Stone Age Secrets)
description:
What did ancient humans actually do for pleasure? Did they spend 24/7 fighting mammoths and shivering in dark caves? The shocking reality from archaeology and anthropology reveals prehistoric humans worked LESS than you do today — leaving 4 to 6 hours of pure free time every single day!

From 9,000-year-old fruit wine cocktails and 40-gallon temple beer vats, to 40,000-year-old vulture bone flutes, prehistoric gambling with animal knucklebones, and flickering cave art cinema... here is the untold story of Stone Age fun!

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS:
0:00 - The Prehistoric Myth (Less Work Than Today!)
0:39 - The World's First Booze & Prehistoric Parties
1:27 - Stone Age Romance, Flutes & Aphrodisiacs
2:17 - Prehistoric Gaming & High-Stakes Gambling
3:01 - Cave Cinema & 36,000-Year-Old Cartoons
3:42 - Why Pleasure Saved the Human Species & Outro
